review: The House of Spiders: The Ring Apprentice Faust is a Charge-based Bleed Identity who REALLY wants to be fielded alongside The House of Spiders: The Ring Nursefather Hong Lu for maximum efficiency, in a similar fashion to Full Stop Duo. First, she has a total of 5 unique statuses: - Corpus Ingredients is a unique Charge that works the same way as a normal Charge does. - Iron Maiden is the state she will be in during the first few turns, giving Aggro, Protection, Defense Level Up and Shield. Lastly, when Ring Faust is hit, it deals damage to attackers and inflicts 2 Bleed Count for each skill with a maximum of 6 Bleed Count each turn. This state allows her to sponge some hits with low consequences for the first few turns, especially when Sanity is not at maxed yet. - Artwork: Fascia, obtained upon spending 10 Corpus Ingredients, allows her to switch state and gain bonuses, up to 2 Base Pow
